function.name: humans.Ask
function.description: Ask the human user a question and wait for their free-form text answer. Use this to clarify requirements, confirm plans or request decisions that cannot be answered by inspecting the codebase.

question.description: The complete question to present to the human user, e.g. "Which target platforms should this project support?"

function.name: humans.Choose
function.description: Ask the human user a question and let them select one or more answers from a fixed list of options. Use this for decisions with a bounded set of sensible answers.

question.description: The complete question to present to the human user, e.g. "Which database should the project use?"

options.description: The list of selectable answers, e.g. ["PostgreSQL", "SQLite", "MongoDB"]. At least one option is required.

multiple.description: Whether the user may select more than one option. Defaults to false for a single selection.
